title: Cloud recovery never reports an unread inbox file as a delegation
goal: When failover exhausted cloud and local inference, cloud_recovery wrote '<data>/delegations/{antigravity,codex}_request_<ts>.md' and reported 'Recovery is pending with external agents: antigravity, codex'. No process in core or commercial reads that directory, so the claim described work nobody was doing. Remove the inbox write; antigravity and codex go through the same plane-bus external_run as the other fallback agents.
results: Found by lane modelpick's live run (reply named antigravity, codex). git grep of both repos' origin/main: the only writers of a 'delegations' dir are this function and GMCP's IDE tool (which waits for its own response file); no reader. susi-gawd-swarm lib 425 passed / 0 failed with a source guard test; clippy -D warnings on susi-gawd-swarm, susi-gawd, susi-daemon (all targets) clean; guards architecture 43, core_docs 5, ceilings 2, orphan 3, task_records 3.
limitations: The guard test reads this file's source; behaviour of plane-bus external agents is unchanged. GMCP's IDE delegation tool is a separate, bounded request/response path and is not touched.
